senses.gloss: m. (preced. wds.) [twist,] צ׳ דקל band made of palm-bark (cmp. נֵצֶר III).—Pl. constr. צוּרֵי.
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 90b:3">Sabb. 90ᵇ</cite> <he>צ׳ דקל שתים</he> (Ms. M. <he>צַוָּארֵי</he>; Ar. <cite ref="R00762"><he>צָרֵי</he></cite>) he who carries palm-bands abroad (on the Sabbath), has transgressed the law by carrying two strips.
